nodes.title: Start here · What is a decision model?
widgets_values:
READ FIRST: We are building a moving artwork that responds to a described scene. A decision model reads a state and question, ranks allowed labels, and returns a distribution. A separate authored map converts the selected label to a creative control.
Open Tutorial 0 with the book button below. It explains the theory, each node type, why choices are authored, and how to read results. No model or download is needed.
